text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri on two-day visit to Spain starting Wednesday to strengthen cooperation over drug trafficking and illegal immigration and to seek reinforcement of bilateral relations.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj attends annual meeting of World Bank and International Monetary Fund in Washington.
- Managing director of loss-making private television channel 2M outlines plans to increase its capital by 158 million dirhams ($18.1 million) by end 1996.
- Road accident kills three near coastal city of El Jadida.
- World Bank to grant Morocco a $170 million loan to finance social policy.
